title: Pure Therion
summary: Therion cards with Endless Engine Argyro System, generic Rank 7s, Rank 8s, Links and staples. Each Therion monster summons itself from the hand by equipping a Therion, or a monster of its own Type, from your GY. The equipped monster then hands its bonus effect to the new holder. Therion "Lily" Borea searches a Therion Spell/Trap, Therion "King" Regulus sends a Therion to negate an activation, and Therion "Bull" Ain destroys one of your Therion cards and one of theirs. Endless Engine Argyro System mills a Therion and later trades places with one in the GY. Therion Irregular, the newest card, equips three Therions at once and discards Argyro to destroy every card they control. Therion Discolosseum searches a Therion and absorbs battle losses. Therion Cross negates or banishes a monster that activates.
